revised_intake.creative_intent: Single manufactured object with immediate matte ceramic readability.

must_have: exactly one manufactured object as the clear subject
visible rim and bevel contour evidence
material visibly attached to the object
visible edge, rim, bevel, seam, or contour evidence

composition.framing: single dominant object centered in frame
composition.camera: macro close-up with readable contour evidence

anti_drift_rules: always preserve one clearly readable manufactured object
do not allow abstract, texture-only, or atmosphere-first subject drift
keep material identity explicit and stable
success_criteria: image does not read as plaster, stone, or glossy plastic
